name: noir
description: 2D · deep warm-dark background with a vignette, light serif headline that alternates between top and bottom, large phone in a gold bezel.
design_notes: Premium dark look. Deep brown-black background with a soft vignette. Light regular-weight serif headline, centred, alternating between the top and the bottom of the slide. The phone is large, front-facing, in a thin gold bezel and bleeds off the edge. Needs a system serif font such as Georgia; falls back to the bundled sans.
